hypothesis: Every eth_call opens an MDBX read transaction that the read-tx-timeout manager tracks (DashMap insert/remove and an is_timed_out check under the txn mutex, visible in the light profile). --db.read-transaction-timeout=0 disables the timeout, removing that bookkeeping.
llm_commentary: --db.read-transaction-timeout=0 is neutral everywhere once compared with the settled same-boot control (exp-cfg-control-end): c8a 4.67s vs 4.70s, c8i 5.47 vs 5.50s, c8g 6.35 vs 6.38s, all within run spread. The "+8.8% vs parent" shown for c8a is an artifact: the opening control ran ~8 minutes after boot and was inflated by first-boot activity (5.12s vs 4.70s for the same build later; FEEDBACK F10). The per-transaction timeout bookkeeping seen in the light profile is not a measurable cost at this request rate.
